instruction:
Compare six lighthouses using official HTML. For Eddystone, Bishop Rock, Beachy Head and Start Point, use Trinity House records to report the present tower's construction year, tower height, light elevation and its datum, labelled automation year and nautical-mile range. Keep earlier towers and distinct automation/unmanning dates separate; retain conflicting source dates. Use labelled key-fact years to calculate construction-to-automation differences, showing inputs, and convert the four ranges using 1NM=1.852km to two decimals. For Cape Hatteras, use the US Coast Guard Historian's record at https://www.history.uscg.mil/Browse-by-Topic/Assets/Land/Lighthouses-Light-Stations/Article/1944529/cape-hatteras-lighthouse/ to compare its labelled first-lit year with the narrative's first-exhibition date, and distinguish heights measured above ground, foundation-to-roof and at the light. For Bodie Island, use https://www.nps.gov/caha/planyourvisit/bils.htm to record the first two towers' heights and abandonment/destruction years, the third tower's first-light date and its electrification year. Convert the distinctly labelled US feet measurements using 1ft=0.3048m to two decimals. Finish with three comparability cautions about replacement towers, height datums and electrification versus automation. Cite every date/measurement; do not use navigation charts or photographs as evidence.

Stopping condition: Stop when four Trinity House records and calculations, both US chronology/height comparisons, the supported unit conversions and three source-based cautions are complete.

Constraints:
- Only use the browser actions available to you. Do not open API endpoints, raw data files, view-source pages or downloads, and do not use external programs.
- Do not sign in or create accounts. Do not provide anyone's private personal information; use only task-supplied fictional values if an interaction requests personal details.
- Remain read-only: do not purchase, reserve, apply, post, send messages, contact people or change external records.
- Navigation, search, filtering, sorting and read-only form or calculator interactions are allowed.
- Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, CAPTCHAs or access challenges. Dismiss optional prompts without creating an account or supplying personal information.
- Support the answer with observed page evidence and source URLs. For values that can change, report what the site shows during the run. Preserve the requested dates, units and scope; report unavailable information explicitly instead of inventing it.

items.description: Extract the present tower's construction year, tower height, light elevation and datum, automation year, and NM range from the Trinity House website. Calculate the construction-to-automation difference (showing inputs) and convert the NM range to km (using 1NM=1.852km to two decimals). Maintain separate dates for earlier towers/unmanning. Full credit if all elements are correctly extracted, calculated, and converted, or if specific data is genuinely missing on the site and reported as such. Partial credit for missing some fields or miscalculating. Use the labelled key-fact years for the year difference and retain conflicting source dates.

items.criterion: US Coast Guard Historian Record: Cape Hatteras
items.description: Extract data from the provided USCG URL for Cape Hatteras. Must compare the labelled first-lit year with the narrative's first-exhibition date, and distinguish the three specific heights (above ground, foundation-to-roof, and at the light). Full credit if all points are identified and distinguished accurately, or if unavailability/site errors are reported. Partial credit if some data is missed or not properly distinguished. Convert each reported feet measurement to metres using 1ft=0.3048m, to two decimals, keeping its measurement datum explicit.

Extract data from the provided NPS URL for Bodie Island. Must record the first two towers' heights and abandonment/destruction years, the third tower's first-light date and electrification year, and convert distinct US feet measurements to meters (1ft=0.3048m to two decimals). Full credit if all data is correctly extracted and converted, or if unavailability/site errors are reported. Partial credit for missed fields or conversion errors.

Provide three comparability cautions regarding: 1) replacement towers, 2) height datums, and 3) electrification versus automation. Full credit if all three specific cautions are logically presented based on the findings. Partial credit if 1 or 2 cautions are provided or if they miss the specified themes.

Cite every date and measurement using the HTML text source URLs. Must NOT use navigation charts or photographs as evidence. Full credit if all data is properly cited to text/HTML sources and no charts/photos are used. Partial credit if some citations are missing. No credit if charts/photos are primarily used for extraction.
